quality.heading: Rendering quality
quality.explain: The scene opens at full quality and steps down only if this device cannot hold the frame rate. You can override that.
quality.fullDetail: Everything on: surface relief, cloud decks, atmospheres, corona, bloom, 900 ring particles per band.
quality.balancedDetail: Relief and clouds kept; corona, bloom and shadows dropped. Fewer ring particles.
quality.essentialDetail: No perpetual motion and no per-pixel extras. Same data, same design.

curve.description: The brightness of {star} dips by {depth} when {planet} crosses in front of it. The planet completes an orbit every {period}.
